background_image_description: The image shows a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. The clouds are primarily fluffy and appear at various heights and shapes. The blue sky dominates the frame, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.

nodes.asset_description: A light blue sky with scattered white clouds of varying sizes. The clouds are dispersed across the sky, with some areas appearing denser than others. A small, bright star-like object is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.

An open book with cream-colored pages displays dense text in a serif typeface. The pages are numbered and contain paragraphs of text arranged in columns. The book has a dark cover and is set against a dark background.

A white, hand-drawn oval shape is centered on a transparent background. The oval is slightly irregular, with some uneven edges and faint, light-colored markings along its perimeter. The background consists of a grid of gray and white squares.
A horizontal white line is centered on a black background. The line is slightly curved and has a small gap in the middle.
